items.q: Q: How much does carpet removal cost in Pickering, Ontario?
a: A: Our Pickering carpet removal pricing is 100% volume-based — you pay based on how much space your carpet, underpad and debris fill in our truck, not by the hour or square foot. Prices start at $125 for small loads. We provide a free on-site estimate before any work begins. The price you approve is the price you pay — fair, flat and final.

items.q: Q: Do you offer same-day carpet removal in Pickering?
a: A: Yes — same-day carpet removal is available across all of Pickering including Frenchman’s Bay, Bay Ridges, Seaton, Dunbarton, Rougemount and all surrounding Durham Region communities. We operate 7 days a week, 6AM to 11PM. Call +1 647 922 5865 to confirm today’s availability.

items.q: Q: Do you tear out the carpet, or does it need to be cut and rolled already?
a: A: We handle the complete tear-out. Our crew cuts, rolls and removes the carpet, pulls up the underpad, and removes tack strips and staples on request — then sweeps the subfloor so it’s ready for your new flooring. If you’ve already pulled it up yourself, we’re happy to just haul it away too.

items.q: Q: Do you remove carpet from stairs and basements?
a: A: Yes — stairs and basements are the two most requested carpet removal jobs in Pickering. Stair tear-outs, including runners and full-wrap installations, and basement carpet removal — including damp, musty or water-damaged carpet — are all part of our standard service.

items.q: Q: Can you remove water-damaged or flooded carpet in Pickering?
a: A: Yes — we remove water-damaged, flood-soaked and mould-affected carpet and underpad quickly, which is critical for preventing further damage to your subfloor. Fast, same-day removal is available for these urgent situations.
